subject: POC runway smoothing & conditional discount schedule
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@clearmap.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Sep 2025 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — short extension + pricing options for POC

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team loved the latency and the KV cache demo. We ran into one snag: our data ingestion team needs another two weeks to finish the anonymization step, which means the current 30-day POC window will probably fall short for the key validation tests.

Can Redwood do either:
- a 14-day extension at no additional cost (we'd prefer credits rather than more invoicing), or
- a 30-day extension if we commit to a small pilot purchase (6 months reserved capacity) with a modest discount?

We also have procurement working on the SOW and they'd like to understand the conditional discount schedule you can offer if we convert to dedicated capacity after the POC. If you have a one-pager or a pricing model we can review that would help speed internal approvals.

Interested in a quick call today or Monday to align.

Appreciate it —
Alyssa
Alyssa Chen
Head of Data Platform | ClearMap AI


From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@clearmap.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Sep 2025 13:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — short extension + pricing options for POC

Hi Alyssa —

We can absolutely help here. Two practical options that keep things simple for procurement:

1) Short runway (recommended): 14-day no-cost extension implemented as a credit bucket applied to your existing POC. We will issue a credit note you can apply against any overage.

2) Commitment path: 30-day extension + staged conditional discount if you commit to a 6-month reserved capacity within 30 days of conversion. Proposed schedule in brief: 8% discount on base compute for the first 3 months, stepping to 5% thereafter; plus a one-time $12k onboarding credit applied at contract execution.

I've attached a first-pass schedule and a lightweight pricing model for you to run by procurement (POC_Schedule_v2.pdf, pricing_model_clearMap.xlsx). If either option looks good we can turn this into an addendum (or a short signature page) and route it through DocuSign.

I can hop on a 20-min call at 3p PT today. Ben is on the thread and can join.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: POC_Schedule_v2.pdf, pricing_model_clearMap.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Sep 2025 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Quick ask — short extension + pricing options for POC

Looping Marissa for approval on the deal sweetener.

Stephanie suggested 2 options — 14-day credit or 30-day extension with staged discount + $12k onboarding credit. ClearMap looks like a high-prob account (data infra leader, likely to move to reserved capacity if the POC proves out).

My ask: can we approve up to an 8% conditional discount (front-loaded) and the $12k onboarding credit for a trade where they sign a 6-month reserved commit within 30 days of conversion? Also want to confirm whether we require a minimum ARR threshold for the pricing tier.

Thanks —
Ben
Senior AE | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Sep 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick ask — short extension + pricing options for POC

Ben — approved with a couple of guardrails.

We can offer:
- a 7–14 day no-cost credit extension (7 days default, 14 if they need engineering support to finish ingestion)
- a one-time $12k onboarding credit (applied on first invoice)
- conditional discount: 8% for first quarter of reserved capacity if they sign a 6-month commit within 30 days of go-live; 5% thereafter.

Guardrails: discount only applies to base compute rate (not premium add-ons like priority support or custom kernels). Must have an executed reserved capacity SLA (minimum $60k commit over 6 months). Credit is non-refundable and applied to invoices.

Approve Ben to present this. If procurement pushes for 10% we push back — offer 9% only with exec approval.

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@clearmap.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Clearmap AI Legal <legal@clearmap.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Final offer: 7-day runway + conditional convertible discount (summary & next steps)

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks for the quick sync earlier this week. Per our conversation here is the agreed path to keep the POC on track while giving your procurement team a clean conversion trigger: 

Summary (what Redwood will provide):
- 7-day no-cost extension added as a credit to your current POC. If engineering needs hands-on assistance we will extend to 14 days (we can toggle when you confirm).
- One-time onboarding credit: $12,000 applied to your first paid invoice if you convert to reserved capacity.
- Conditional discount on reserved capacity: 8% off base compute for the first 3 months if ClearMap signs a 6-month reserved commit within 30 days of go-live. After the first 3 months the discount steps to 5% for the remainder of the 6-month term. Discounts exclude premium support and custom engineering work.

Procurement ask: please confirm whether you prefer the 7- or 14-day extension (and whether you want us to include the optional engineering hours clause). We will prepare an addendum and route via DocuSign. I attached the updated schedule and a DocuSign link for the signature page.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/clear/12345-POC-SCHEDULE
Attachments: POC_Schedule_v2.pdf, pricing_model_clearMap.xlsx

If that all looks good I can have the addendum in DocuSign today and route to your legal team.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192
